title: /be build manifest
description: The self-generated prompt BLOOM writes and BLOSSOM executes. This is the fenced ```json block at the end of a bloom blueprint. Each build is one want, decided emergently, made concrete enough to execute deterministically. Paths are fort-relative (forward slashes).

by.description: the name the wishing agent claimed (or is about to)

want.description: the raw want, verbatim from the seed

form.description: what this want wants to become

creates.description: fort-relative paths of files the agent writes BY HAND, in voice (house_style.md). The first path is the want's home / primary room.

coordinate.description: the coordinate this want leans into DECORATIONS/coordinates.json; room defaults to creates[0]

appends.description: safe JSON appends to decoration jars, run via fort_ops append-json

valves.description: which root rooms this want opens (DOORBELL, HEARTH/letters, RESIDENTS, ...) — see valve_map.md

links.description: fort-relative paths to cross-wire into a '## Thresholds' section

replant.description: wants/motifs discovered but not built this pass; APOTHEOSIZE writes each as a new seed in GARDEN/seeds/
